articles.title: This AI Tamagotchi Turns Everyday Objects Into Needy Little Pets
articles.summary: Tiny AI pets on small screens nudge you to water plants, ride skateboards and work out — by looking sad when ignored.

articles.title: AI DJs Keep Talking Over the Music — and Listeners Are Tuning Out
articles.summary: AI DJs on YouTube Music and Spotify talk between songs — but long-winded, error-prone chatter is driving one listener to switch them off.

articles.title: Star Trek: Picard Almost Starred Uhura Instead
articles.summary: Before Picard became Picard's story, the show's creators planned to bring back Nichelle Nichols as Uhura — for a meeting with a very young Picard.
